state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
other_conditions: Applicant must not be availing financial assistance under any other Divyang Pension schemes
If age proof is unavailable, the beneficiary shall be referred to the Medical Board of the concerned district for verification of age
After attaining age of 60 years, the beneficiary shall be transferred to the Pension Scheme to Old Age Persons (Senior Citizen)
benefits_summary: Eligible beneficiaries receive a financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
